elements.label: Table 4.2
elements.title: Typical Values of z_c for Various Confidence Levels
elements.details:
| Confidence Level   | Value of z_c |
|--------------------|--------------|
| 80% confidence     | 1.280        |
| 90% confidence     | 1.645        |
| 95% confidence     | 1.960        |
| 99% confidence     | 2.575        |
elements.summary: This table lists typical critical z-values corresponding to common confidence levels used in constructing confidence intervals.

elements.label: Figure 4.2
elements.title: Critical Values of z_c Marked on Standard Normal Curve for 95% Confidence Interval

details.trend: Symmetric bell curve with shaded central area of 0.95 between -1.96 and 1.96, tails each with area 0.025.

elements.summary: This figure shows the standard normal distribution curve with critical z-values marked at -1.96 and 1.96, illustrating the 95% confidence interval where the central 95% area is shaded.
